title: The Missing Moonlight
premise: Moonlight is disappearing from the habitats. Eight local beacons once shared it; Warden Vell’s Stillworks collectors now divert it into one Observatory reserve. Restore the routes, discover why, and build a team capable of bringing the light home.

objectives.immediate: Solve the current route, encounter or companion request.
objectives.medium: Develop a complementary team, earn the next seal and revisit a known mystery with its ability.
objectives.long: Restore eight beacons, resolve the Observatory crisis and befriend all twelve companions.

scope.core: Authored single-player campaign with NPC exchanges and all twelve mechanic roles.
scope.humanSocial: Designed paired-play extension; requires separate account/session implementation and review, not a prerequisite for the campaign.
scope.generation: Future proposed JSON expansions, never required for the core.

mechanics.rule: Track habitat clues, observe preferences and complete a help encounter to invite a companion.
mechanics.feedsInto: A missing guide entry suggests a habitat; recruitment adds a new affinity and field option.

mechanics.rule: Four first-time milestone grants per friend lead to levels 2–5, technique choices and a visible Wayfinder form.
mechanics.feedsInto: A new technique improves a trial solution; the trial opens new training contexts.

mechanics.rule: Collect twelve; travel with two; equip two techniques per friend plus universal actions.
mechanics.feedsInto: Choose a matching specialist and a support partner, or spend a supply to cover a missing affinity.

mechanics.rule: Connected hubs, routes, habitats, shortcuts and landmarks visible before access.
mechanics.feedsInto: A far-off island creates a future goal that ferry ability later resolves.

mechanics.rule: Seals license five world abilities; matching friends reveal bonuses; equivalent tools keep the route available.
mechanics.feedsInto: A new seal changes old locations and reveals recruitment clues and useful items.

mechanics.rule: Turn-based friendly contests and environmental encounters use energy, pressure, affinities and preparation.

mechanics.rule: Eight keeper trials combine an investigation, a world project and a tactical finale.
mechanics.feedsInto: Every seal changes the map and supplies evidence for the central mystery.

mechanics.rule: Expedition energy and a three-item pouch create push-on-or-rest decisions; camps restore for free.
mechanics.feedsInto: Saving a snack can extend an expedition; resting changes the route taken, not ownership or XP.

mechanics.rule: Rowan and Vell recur with changed beliefs and strategies, reacting to your earlier choices.
mechanics.feedsInto: Rowan’s overworked partner makes team rotation and care matter to the plot.

mechanics.rule: Environmental deductions, deliveries, rescues, optional designs and two-solution obstacles.
mechanics.feedsInto: A fossil choice becomes an exchange opportunity and another habitat clue.

mechanics.rule: Early silhouettes and inaccessible landmarks resolve through return visits and a post-finale sanctuary.
mechanics.feedsInto: The final rare friend completes the mystery and offers a distinct late collection goal.

mechanics.rule: Authored NPC barter in the core; a specified paired expedition and keepsake exchange mode for human players.
mechanics.feedsInto: Players share discovery clues and complementary roles; no friend or ending requires multiplayer.

tactics.affinityRule: Matching the encounter affinity adds 2 progress. Other affinities retain base progress; there is no immunity.
tactics.energyStarts: Current expedition energy; a camp restores each friend to their level maximum.
tactics.rallyRule: Rally and chime set a single pending partner bonus; later use replaces rather than stacks it. Only a progress move by the other companion consumes it; expires at encounter end. Trail marker is separate and consumed by the next progress move.
tactics.failure: Return to the last camp with party, clues, XP and mission inventory intact; fully restore energy. Consumed optional supplies remain consumed; keeper tool charges reset each attempt.
tactics.learning: No academic question per turn. Incorrect academic answers never damage companions, raise pressure or consume items.
tactics.switching: Choose either travelling companion each turn without spending a separate turn; changing the travelling pair is available at camp.
tactics.retry: Encounter seed, committed turns and supplies persist across reload; restart begins at camp, never duplicates rewards.
tactics.preview: The next hazard is always visible with words and icons; reveal also shows the following hazard. No reflex timing.

keeperTool.availability: Free loan during every trial preparation, available to every starter and kept for that attempt. Does not require the seal being earned; permanent field use unlocks after the trial.

tactics.resolution: Apply actor energy cost and progress, including matching +2 and a pending partner/marker bonus. Clear only bonuses consumed by a progress move. Win if target reached. Otherwise reduce this turn’s hazard by the move/item shield, add remaining hazard to pressure, then lose at pressure >= limit or completed turns >= roundLimit. Rest caps at level maximum. No residual shield.
tactics.loadouts: At level one the signature technique is equipped. Level two adds rally as a second technique. Universal focus/guard/rest remain available. The level-three choice modifies signature or rally; one free signature is consumed only on a successful signature action and resets at camp.
tactics.phases: Use the affinity of the highest phase threshold reached BEFORE the move. Progress carries between phases without resetting energy, pressure, turn count or tool charges. The next threshold and affinity are visible; crossing a threshold changes the following turn.

progression.friendship: Distinct verified shared quests and preferences; no academic score or repeated petting reward.
progression.legacy: No historical XP inferred; existing earned XP, appearances and grants retained under their original policy.
progression.trainingDelivery: Four unique activity instances per companion, themed by their affinity and personal quest. A recruited friend can begin every story-unlocked milestone in level order, including after the ending. Tactical replays and repeated care never create extra XP.
progression.rewardTiming: Level-three technique choice is offered upon reaching 20 XP; level-four keepsake on completing personal-project; level-five Wayfinder form on completing wayfinder. Distinct art is required before presentation is claimed implemented.

items.effect: Restore 2 energy to one companion, capped at level maximum.
Reduce current-turn pressure by 2, minimum zero.
Next progress move receives +2 once; does not stack with another marker.

sources.reset: After resolving a previously uncompleted project, trial or personal quest; never on reload.
sources.purpose: Enough material for one of each optional supply; none is required for a story solution.

resources.missionSupplies: Reserved per quest, separate from pouch; cannot be sold, traded or spent on optional recipes.
care: Free rest restores energy at a camp.
Ask about a favourite activity; choose play, grooming or a snack animation without consuming expedition supplies.
Distinct personal moments change memories and dialogue. No neglect, death or loss while away.

sideQuests.objective: Notice the sealed lens room. Copy its star mark; revisit after seal-beacon preparation grants keeper access.
sideQuests.payoff: Recover the lighthouse lens during beacon-project; the early clue changes Sail’s greeting.

sideQuests.objective: Choose a leaf fossil or a shell fossil from the mill foundations; restore it at Cleo’s workbench.
sideQuests.payoff: A keepsake and clue to a garden or shore side route. NPC exchange later supplies the other fossil without losing a companion.

sideQuests.objective: Return with ferry ability or folding raft to the island visible from the opening scene.
sideQuests.payoff: An old beacon blueprint and a unique charm; the blueprint explains the distributed system before Vell admits it.

sideQuests.objective: Try Rowan’s changed two-partner team in a friendly three-round relay.
sideQuests.payoff: A partner ribbon for using two affinities. Supported play can earn the same ribbon; no exclusive best-time reward.

sideQuests.objective: Use the eight seals to open the sanctuary and help Glimmer guide the last displaced creatures home.
sideQuests.payoff: Recruit Glimmer, complete the twelve-friend guide and unlock the sanctuary rest camp.

exchanges.source: After restoring either fossil, Cleo provides two copies of its rubbing; one is for exchange.
Copy an already recorded clue at a camp for free; the original is retained.

social.mode: Paired expedition with a known invited partner; local shared-device play first, network play later.
social.turns: Alternate roles after every encounter; each player controls their own companion. Both must confirm the expedition start.
social.exchange: Exchange duplicate keepsake rubbings or authored clue cards; show both offers and confirm both sides atomically. Never transfer companion ownership or learning evidence.
social.progress: Each profile receives only its own verified participating quest grants. A partner answer is supported participation, never independent evidence for the other learner.
social.availability: Every reward has an authored NPC or solo equivalent. No version-exclusive friends, random public matchmaking or free-text chat.
social.completion: Disconnection preserves the last confirmed turn and offers solo continuation; no unconfirmed exchange commits.

worldChanges: All three regions regain visible light and habitat activity.
Rowan becomes a cooperative expedition partner.
postgame: Complete all twelve field-guide entries and personal quests.
Revisit the opening island, fossil routes and habitat caches.
Attempt optional remixed trial boards with fixed authored patterns, no additional milestone XP.

contentPolicy.authority: Rust validates actions and commits progress, supplies, rewards and evidence atomically.
contentPolicy.learning: Use the current curriculum frontier; supported completion earns identical adventure rewards with separate evidence.
contentPolicy.generation: LLM may propose packs using this schema and approved IDs; validate graph, recipes, exact trial solutions and content review before activation.
contentPolicy.saves: Pin campaign/version/mission/turn/recipient/grant IDs; exact retries retain command body. Explicit opt-in adoption of existing saves, no reset.
contentPolicy.runtimeStatus: New routes, characters, challenges, forms and quests require implementation and assets; this JSON is an authored design, not an executable runtime pack.
